test: Manifest has name, standalone display, start_url and both icons that exist with the declared sizes
Service worker registers, activates and controls the page after one reload
iOS home-screen tags present (apple-touch-icon 180px, capable, status bar, title) and theme-color set
With the SERVER STOPPED, the installed shell still opens, shows the cached queue and plays a cached clip
evidence: opened and played with the server down; chip said offline

test: Start with no player name: blocked with a message, no answer is recorded
evidence: Enter a player name or ID first

test: Empty content folder (no queue yet): app opens, says so, no script errors
evidence: queue says 'No queue yet. Connect once to load it.', play says 'No pitches yet. Connect once to load the queue.'

test: Very first load while offline (nothing cached): fails safely, no crash loop
evidence: browser shows its offline page; the app needs one online visit to install (documented)

test: Both questions per clip: 2 rows, same clip_trial, q_order 1 and 2, different tasks
Question order is randomized: across the pack both orders occur, and the same clip keeps the same order
Ask 'zone' only: one row per clip, task zone
Ask 'pitch' only: one row per clip, task pitch
Training: each answer is scored against the shipped key; verdicts on screen match the stored correct flag
Assessment: no feedback, no reveal playback, no answers in the page or the queue file, stored key is blank
Run block: plays every pitch in the queue once, auto-advances, ends with 'Done'
Keyboard: G, N and Space work (for a desktop or Bluetooth keyboard)
Pack completion: the Start button comes back and the queue marks the pitches done after a reload
evidence: hero now says: NEXT UP: RANDOM: SCOTT BARLOW

test: Every stored answer has all fields; times are plausible; ids unique
Sync twice and concurrently: server holds exactly the local count, nothing duplicated
Server CSV is read by the recognition profile code and produces a profile (end to end, no exceptions)
Reload keeps answers, settings and the 'done' state
Erase on this phone really clears answers and resets the sync chip
Server unreachable during sync: clear message, answers stay unsynced, later sync succeeds with nothing lost
evidence: failed sync -> chip '1 to sync', net 'offline'; retry stored 1

test: CSV formula injection: a player name like =cmd|... must not reach a spreadsheet cell as a formula (app export and server CSV)
Clip not on the phone and no signal: a clear message, no crash, state recovers
evidence: This clip is not on the phone and there is no signal.

test: The server disappears right after a clip starts: the pitch, the question and the answer all still work (server really stopped, not browser offline emulation)
Double-tapping GO records ONE answer for that question
Start tapped repeatedly: one playback, one set of trials
During a pitch the tab bar is hidden (focus mode); the question appears and is answered; the tabs return afterwards
Reload in the middle of a question: no half-written answers, app recovers to idle
evidence: kept the one completed answer; the unfinished clip is simply asked again

test: Corrupt clip file in storage: the app reports it and recovers, it does not hang in 'playing'
evidence: state after corrupt clip: idle; message 'Tap Start pitch to allow video'

test: Landscape orientation: question buttons are on screen without scrolling
iPhone SE 1st gen 320x568: no sideways scroll on any tab; GO/NO-GO visible without scrolling when a question shows
small Android 360x640: no sideways scroll on any tab; GO/NO-GO visible without scrolling when a question shows
iPhone SE 2/3 375x667: no sideways scroll on any tab; GO/NO-GO visible without scrolling when a question shows
iPhone 14 390x844: no sideways scroll on any tab; GO/NO-GO visible without scrolling when a question shows
Pixel 7 412x915: no sideways scroll on any tab; GO/NO-GO visible without scrolling when a question shows
iPad 820x1180: no sideways scroll on any tab; GO/NO-GO visible without scrolling when a question shows
Tap targets: GO, NO-GO, Start, tabs and sync are at least 44 px tall
Controls have accessible names; images/svg labelled; page has a title and lang
light theme: every tab renders, no script or console errors
dark theme: every tab renders, no script or console errors
Pause lands within 1.5 frames of release+offset for EVERY clip in both queues at 50, 100 and 200 ms
Speed: tap Start to question under 3 s (cached clip); app ready under 2 s on localhost
evidence: ready 0.17 s, start-to-question 1.78 s (includes the clip's own lead-in)

test: Every queue item: file exists, plays, release inside the clip with at least 0.4 s after it; keys agree with the pitch's own location and type
Assessment keys are absent from every public file and present in the private file for every assessment item
evidence: queue files carry null keys for assessment items

test: Footprint: total content and per-clip size reasonable for a phone
Path traversal: ../ and encoded variants cannot read files outside the app and content folders
evidence: no file outside the served folders was readable

test: POST hardening: oversize body, bad JSON, wrong shape, missing ids are all rejected without crashing the server
Shared token: wrong or missing token gets 401 on POST and on the CSV; correct token works
evidence: codes [401, 401, 200]; note: config.json hands the token to anyone who opens the app, so it is a team passcode, not a secret

test: Script injection: hostile player name and hostile pack title never execute
Static server: only GET/POST used; HEAD, OPTIONS and unknown paths answer without killing the server
No uncaught script errors or console errors occurred anywhere in this run
evidence: 1 console lines, none from the app's own code
